items.title: Nat Hentoff interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Armstrong shook up all the musicians, not just the trumpet players.

ctx.x: Yeah, that’s a tough question. So do you think the future for jazz music is healthy? Is it possible to say that?

My main hope is that out of all — and I never anticipated there could be so much emphasis on education. I’m not talking about how to play, you know like the Berklee School of Music. I don’t know if I mentioned this in this interview, I was talking about it downstairs. There’s a place called North Texas State college, they have I don’t know how many big bands, all kinds of small combos. There’s one thing missing. And Benny Carter went there after I did and when I asked Benny what he thought he said, “gee they…
It’s not swinging, ey? I often see the phrase jazz, America’s only true art form.

items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So he had agreed to an interview backstage when it was all over.

ctx.x: Were there any recordings and/or transcriptions made of the many interviews that you did back at that time? Because I know in the ’50s we do have some recordings of these things. But back in ’44 and ’45 and ’46?

No. As a matter of fact, the one – there were two recordings, one then that I feel very bad about. Louis Armstrong had a show at Symphony Hall, where as usual he gave everything he had. But he was a very kind man. So he had agreed to an interview backstage when it was all over. It was about 12, 12:30. For an hour, we started talking about race and what it was like on the road for black musicians, what he’d experienced, etc. That was a side of Louis that – although it became clear later, when he sounded off on…

So you’re recording people on the air, you’re interviewing, and then eventually the live things from the remote. You mentioned at this time – it’s just fascinating to think about your – you were the announcer for Curley, for the mayor. Could you give us a sketch of political corruption in Boston?
